subject.title: fix(doctor): surface multi-account default routing warnings in preview and lint

question: Should `core/doctor/default-account-routing` run as a default warning-level `openclaw doctor --lint` check even though warnings make lint exit nonzero for existing multi-account configs?
rationale: The code path is narrow and covered, but the default lint exit-status change is an operator compatibility policy choice that automation should not decide alone.

options.title: Accept default lint gating
options.body: Land the PR as-is and intentionally make missing explicit multi-account routing fail default doctor lint with warning-severity findings.

options.title: Keep lint non-failing by default
options.body: Keep preview and repair warnings visible but make this structured check opt-in, default-disabled, or info-level for default lint.

options.title: Hold for broader routing policy
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers decide how all multi-account fallback-routing diagnostics should behave in lint gates.

recommendation.title: Accept default lint gating
recommendation.body: Land the PR as-is and intentionally make missing explicit multi-account routing fail default doctor lint with warning-severity findings.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the structured doctor lint/health-check machinery most directly affected by the default lint participation choice.
